title: Problem
问题
html:
Primary source: https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/code-migration. Venue/status: Vals AI benchmark page, 2025. The problem is to evaluate Target-language repository/program submission. under a benchmark surface whose feedback is hidden tests and anti-cheat checks. The decision boundary is evaluation and audit: it is not a training recipe, not a general proof of model reliability, and not a reusable reward unless the official source separately releases that contract.

The data object is composed of source repository, target language, generated migration, hidden test result, anti-cheat result, score. The benchmark matters because it measures a concrete surface that ordinary static QA or single-function coding tests do not fully cover. For screening, read the card with the source version, scorer, split policy, and released artifacts attached to any claimed score.

数据对象包括源仓库、目标语言、生成后的迁移代码、隐藏测试结果、反作弊检查和聚合分数。反馈来自隐藏测试和反作弊规则。边界要收窄到评测和审计：通过测试不等于完全语义等价，也不等于可直接部署。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
One-sentence contribution: Code Migration evaluates whether models can reimplement real-world programs in another language and pass hidden behavioral tests in an offline sandbox. The core mechanism is to turn a realistic task substrate into an observable input-output-scoring contract rather than only reporting model impressions.

Inputs come from Repository-level source program plus target-language migration instructions.; outputs are Target-language repository/program submission.; feedback is Hidden test suite plus anti-cheat checker; CLI score averages across target-language migrations. It belongs under benchmark/evaluation surfaces because the central artifact is the measurement contract. Closest comparisons are other benchmark surfaces in the same domain, but this card should be read at the level of the released task object and scorer rather than as a broad model capability claim.

一句话贡献：Code Migration 把跨语言重实现能力放进仓库级、隐藏测试驱动的评测面中。核心机制是给模型真实源程序和目标语言要求，让它提交可运行的目标语言实现。

输入是源仓库和迁移说明；输出是目标语言程序或仓库；反馈是隐藏测试通过率和反作弊检查。它应归在评测面方向，因为主要贡献是迁移任务、沙箱和评分契约，而不是新的迁移算法。

title: Method
方法
html:
The evaluation pipeline is: present the task input, run the model or agent in the specified substrate, collect the submitted artifact, execute or apply the scorer, and aggregate the result under the official leaderboard/reporting policy. The substrate is Offline coding sandbox with hidden tests.

The verifier/reward component is Hidden test suite plus anti-cheat checker; CLI score averages across target-language migrations. Outputs are interpreted only through that contract; training or optimization use is not assumed. Reproducibility depends on pinning the task version, harness or judge version, model settings, release license, and hidden/public split policy. Artifacts to verify are paper=https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/code-migration, project=https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/code-migration, code=null, data=null.

评测流程是：提供源实现和目标语言，让模型在离线沙箱中生成迁移代码，运行隐藏测试，再用反作弊检查排除可疑提交。官方页面说明，CLI 类任务按多个目标语言和源仓库聚合成绩。

评分组件是隐藏测试套件和反作弊检查。输出只能说明该提交在指定任务、语言和测试下的表现。复现时需要固定仓库版本、目标语言列表、依赖版本、测试阈值、沙箱和隐藏集策略。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence is the official source at https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/code-migration. It identifies the benchmark surface, task form, and feedback contract used for reporting. Where code or data are public, the relevant artifact URLs are code=null and data=null.

The evidence boundary is intentionally narrow. Public pages can establish task intent and scoring language, but they may not expose every prompt, hidden test, judge prompt, or leaderboard filter. Any numerical comparison should therefore cite the exact page snapshot, benchmark version, and evaluator settings.

最强证据来自官方来源 https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/code-migration。该来源能确认评测面的任务形态、对象和反馈契约。若代码或数据公开，对应工件是 code=null，data=null。

证据边界要写清楚：公开页面可以确认评测意图和评分语言，但未必公开全部 prompt、隐藏测试、评审提示词或排行榜过滤规则。任何数值比较都应注明页面快照、benchmark 版本和评估设置。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior baselines are generic benchmark leaderboards, single-answer task sets, or narrower domain tests. What changes here is the measurement surface: it asks whether a model can complete Target-language repository/program submission. under hidden tests and anti-cheat checks.

The direction signal is useful because it moves evaluation toward the artifact or workflow that users actually inspect. The quality signal is strongest when the scorer, split, and artifact version are explicit. What is not new is the general idea of benchmarking models; the reusable contribution is the particular task object plus feedback contract. Reuse checks should ask: pin target-language list, task version, license, and any public/held-out split policy; do not read test pass as full semantic equivalence.

已有基线多关注单题代码生成或同语言修复。这里的新意在于把“保留行为并换语言”作为核心任务，并用隐藏测试检查迁移后的程序。

方向信号来自真实代码迁移场景：模型不仅要写语法正确的代码，还要理解源程序行为和目标语言生态。质量信号取决于隐藏测试覆盖、依赖固定、反作弊策略和任务版本。并不新的部分是用测试评测代码；可复用的部分是跨语言迁移的任务对象和评分契约。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Limitations center on scorer coverage, release boundary, and snapshot drift. A hidden test, human vote, or judge rubric can be appropriate for the benchmark while still missing important semantic failures. Public visibility can also create contamination risk.

Scores should not be read outside the official harness. Different model scaffolds, sampling settings, browser or tool versions, prompt filters, and hidden-set policies can change outcomes. The official page establishes task shape, hidden testing, and anti-cheat policy; artifact availability may be partial or private.

主要限制来自测试覆盖和等价性边界。隐藏测试可以发现许多行为错误，但不能证明迁移程序在所有输入、性能和异常处理上都与源程序完全一致。

分数不能脱离官方沙箱解释。依赖版本、目标语言、测试阈值、脚手架和反作弊规则都会影响结果。官方页面能确认任务形态、隐藏测试和反作弊策略；公开工件是否完整仍需按当前发布版本核验。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this card to decide whether Code Migration Benchmark is the right evaluation surface for a model, agent, or system claim. It is especially useful when the claim concerns the same artifact type and feedback contract described above.

For collection and comparison, record the official source URL, benchmark version, model setup, and scorer. Avoid using the benchmark name alone as evidence; the useful unit is the pinned task/scorer/snapshot tuple.

这张卡适合用来判断 Code Migration Benchmark 是否匹配某个模型、智能体或系统声明。只有当声明涉及同类任务工件和同类反馈契约时，它才是强证据。

用于比较时，应记录官方来源、benchmark 版本、模型设置和评分器。不要只引用 benchmark 名称；真正有意义的单位是固定后的任务、评分器和快照。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read the official source first, then inspect public artifacts if available. Confirm title/version, release date, task count, scorer, split policy, license, and whether model scores are from a live leaderboard or a static report.

Watch for overclaims: benchmark success is not the same as trustworthy deployment, full correctness, or training signal quality. If an artifact is private, record that boundary explicitly rather than filling it with inference.

阅读顺序是先看官方页面，再看公开代码或数据。需要确认标题和版本、发布日期、任务数量、评分器、划分策略、许可协议，以及分数来自动态排行榜还是静态报告。

警惕过度解释：benchmark 成功不等于可部署可信、完全正确或适合作为训练信号。如果某些工件不公开，应把这个边界写明，而不是用推测补齐。
